# Customer Proof AI Layer

> An Aurics Lab prototype that turns rough customer material into governed customer proof
> GTM teams can safely reuse. Subtitle: Rebuilding Customer Advocacy & Marketing to be AI-native.

Core principle: AI structures and adapts customer proof. Humans approve what is true,
current, commercially useful, and safe to use.

Product promise: make customer proof searchable, approved, measurable, and reusable
across GTM teams.

Ownership: Customer Advocacy & Marketing / Product Marketing owns the proof record. Sales, CS, Marketing,
Website, AR/PR, and Events use it.

## Customer Proof Record fields
1. Customer context
2. Proof priority
3. Buyer problem
4. Approved proof
5. Use controls (evidence strength, approval status, permission, customer load)

## Outputs generated from approved proof
1. Proof summary for Sales outreach
2. Business expansion note
3. Marketing case study brief
4. Website proof block
5. External approved proof note

## Governance check applied to every output
- Source attached
- Permission checked
- Approval checked
- Claim scope preserved

## Pages
- https://customer-proof-ai-layer.lovable.app/: start, sample records or your own notes
- https://customer-proof-ai-layer.lovable.app/create: create a Customer Proof Record from raw material
- https://customer-proof-ai-layer.lovable.app/record: review the governed record
- https://customer-proof-ai-layer.lovable.app/use: generate role-specific outputs with governance checks
- https://customer-proof-ai-layer.lovable.app/library: search and filter proof records
- https://customer-proof-ai-layer.lovable.app/metrics: proof system health metrics
- https://customer-proof-ai-layer.lovable.app/expansion: how this could expand
